name: Sanctuary of Petals
detailed_description:
Pretty as a lamb and its gentle skin. Blue as a wish and its morbid sin.

A plague wipes out many people's abilities to lie, purifying them— evolving them. Or so they say.

But you? Your body rots as you retain your ability to lie. Flee, little bird, flee to the place they whisper of, before they catch your tongue. That castle across the lake, with the long, long bridge.

Choose the path you will take—who you might learn to love. Choose whether you will lie, or tell the truth.

Oh, and, fragile dove? Beware of the sweet monsters in the night. 

Play through this visual novel where choices matter, and each lie you tell holds a heavy weight... Decide who you will romance in this text-based interactive story, and weave your own destiny as you map your way through the endless maze of halls and doors.

Features of this Visual Novel

🌺 Poetic writing full of twists and turns.

🌺 Re-nameable heroine!

🌺 Chapter based releases for multiple love interests.

🌺 Haunting, original music.

🌺 Sound effects and jump scares!

🌺 Multiple endings.

🌺 Lie Count... So choose carefully.

🌺 In-game choices allow players to shape their own paths.

🌺 More features coming soon!!

short_description: Step into a visual novel of rotten flowers. Play as a young woman in a world where the ability to lie is condemned, and seek shelter in the mysterious castle across the lake. Survive, little dove, in the rot infested halls, and be careful of who you choose to love — what you choose to lie about...
